# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 80 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Grid Builder** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/grid-builder/), a free online CSS grid builder — draw your grid visually, place and merge items, and copy the CSS, all in the browser, **Ethereum Unit Converter** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/eth-unit-converter/), a free online Ethereum unit converter — convert between wei, gwei and ether with exact BigInt arithmetic, plus a gas cost calculator, all computed locally, **Name Picker** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/name-picker/), a free online name picker — paste names and draw a fair winner with crypto-grade randomness, no-repeat mode and winner history, all in the browser, **Seed Phrase Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/seed-phrase-lab/), a free online educational BIP39 seed phrase generator — generate and validate 12–24 word mnemonics with a full 2048-word list, all computed locally, for learning only, **Shadow Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/shadow-generator/), a free online box-shadow designer — drag sliders for offset, blur, spread and opacity, pick a preset, and copy the CSS, all in the browser, **NFT Rarity Calculator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/nft-rarity/), a free online NFT rarity calculator — paste a trait collection as JSON and get trait frequencies, rarity scores and a ranked leaderboard, all computed locally, **White Noise** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/white-noise/), a free online white noise mixer — blend white, pink and brown noise, rain and ocean sounds generated live in your browser, with per-sound volumes and a sleep timer, **Uniswap v3 LP Simulator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/lp-simulator/), a free online DeFi simulator — pick a price range and fee tier, run a seeded price path, and compare fees, impermanent loss and value against simply holding, all simulated data, **Rock Paper Scissors** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/rock-paper-scissors/), a free online rock paper scissors game — play a best-of-five match against a bot that counters your most-played move, first to 3 wins, all in the browser, **Gradient Studio** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/gradient-studio/), a free online gradient studio — layer colours and stops, set the angle, preview live, and copy the CSS, all in the browser,
